"""Generate URL-friendly slugs from titles."""

import re


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    """Convert a title to a slug following the project rules."""
    slug = title.lower()
    slug = slug.replace('&', ' and ')
    slug = ''.join(char for char in slug if char.isascii() and (char.isalnum() or char in ' -'))
    slug = re.sub(r'[ -]+', '-', slug)
    slug = slug.strip('-')

    if len(slug) > 40:
        slug = slug[:40].rstrip('-')

    return slug
